objects.description: During the [2026 U.S. Water Utilities Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0066), the adversary denied operators the ability to control their systems by shutting down and disabling computerized water plant controls via malware over a wireless connection.(Citation: Tenable Minnesota Water Utilities)(Citation: Forescout Water Systems Attack)(Citation: Dragos Water Under Attack)
